replacements.Los modelos VLA convierten observación v: VLA models turn visual observation and textual instruction directly into motor commands. The same process that generates text generates action.
replacements.El modelo ve la escena: objetos, posicio: The model sees the scene: objects, positions and the current state of the arm. All spatial evidence is available.
replacements.\"Coloca el vaso encima de la caja azul\: "Place the glass on top of the blue box"
replacements.El operador describe el objetivo en text: The operator describes the goal in text. There are no coordinates and no control code: only language.
replacements.En un sistema clásico de robótica, la in: In a classical robotics system, the instruction and the scene are processed by separate pipelines. The VLA receives them as a single input sequence.
replacements.La imagen se divide en patches y se proy: The image is divided into patches and projected into token space. Each visual token carries spatial information about its region.
replacements.El transformer procesa tokens visuales y: The transformer processes visual and text tokens together. Attention crosses freely between modalities: each text token can attend to any visual region.
replacements.La instrucción se tokeniza igual que en: The instruction is tokenized just as in a standard LLM. The text tokens carry the semantics of the goal.
replacements.La diferencia clave respecto a un VLM co: The key difference from a conventional VLM
replacements.Un VLM convencional genera tokens de tex: A conventional VLM generates text tokens as output. The VLA generates the next token from the action vocabulary, not from the word vocabulary.
replacements.La salida es una descripción. El sistema: The output is a description. The system reports but does not act.
replacements.La salida es un vector de movimiento eje: The output is a movement vector that can be executed directly by the actuator.
replacements.Los comandos motores se discretizan en u: Motor commands are discretized into a finite vocabulary. The model chooses the next action token in the same way it would choose the next word.
replacements.Nueva imagen del entorno. El estado del: New image of the environment. The state of the world has changed since the previous step.
replacements.Imagen + instrucción + historial de acci: Image + instruction + action history → joint representation → prediction of the next action token.
replacements.El comando motor se envía al actuador. E: The motor command is sent to the actuator. The arm moves. The environment changes.
replacements.el conocimiento web del LLM transfiere d: the LLM's web knowledge transfers directly
replacements.tareas nuevas descritas en lenguaje natu: new tasks described in natural language
replacements.Por qué esto cambia el análisis de riesg: Why this changes the risk analysis
replacements.El mismo razonamiento que en un LLM prod: The same reasoning that produces a discardable incorrect answer in an LLM produces a physical action with effects on the environment in a VLA. A perceptual hallucination at step 1 becomes an incorrect motor command at step 3.
